title: Televised testimony.
bodyText: Victims and witnesses shall have the right to testify at trial by televised two-way closed circuit video to be viewed by the court, the accused, and the trier of fact.
bodyHtml: [§801D-7]  Televised testimony.  Victims and witnesses shall have the right to testify at trial by televised two-way closed circuit video to be viewed by the court, the accused, and the trier of fact. [L 1997, c 320, §2]
